interpretation.instrumented: Actual MemmapSource chunk/chunks intervals intersected with planned leaf/direct TBasket intervals.
interpretation.distinct_baskets: Disjoint on-disk extents; compressed and decompressed TKey totals counted once.
interpretation.excluded: Metadata and other nonbasket source requests; logical request duplicates; no kernel readahead/page-cache or physical IO claim.
interpretation.fLeaves: ROOT branch fLeaves names and TLeaf::fLeafCount names from original metadata. Fetched count-branch test uses the same recorded branch census.
interpretation.uncompressed: Uncompressed payload bytes from TKey fObjlen; key-inclusive adds fKeylen. Includes actual on-disk basket record overhead in the key-inclusive compressed total.
